inspiration: Encounter manager as a small state machine: sleeping, idle, active, panic, despawn, plus an is-active flag (Data/scripts/Encounter_Manager.lua:13-18, 79-91). Fits zone population (row 23).
Probability per encounter slot: base plus adjustment, clamped to 0-100 (Data/scripts/Encounter_Manager.lua:31-32, 119-127). Shape for zone fields: cap, chance, respawn, grace, coverage.
100-percent slots are anchors and survive a normal despawn pass (Data/scripts/Encounter_Manager.lua:225). A rule for boss or quest anchors.
Content and state split: scripts hold zones, spawns, contacts and missions; the database holds player state and supergroups (Data/SCHEMA.md:11-13). Fits one character, one ledger.
Universal spawn definitions reused by name across maps, from a marker slot to a spawn definition (Data/scripts/Universal_Spawns.lua:5-9).
Panic as a timed state with an initiator list (Data/scripts/Encounter_Manager.lua:29-30, 88-90). Idea kept; the timer is declared but not built.
Civilian and car spawns at a marker with random offset and rotation (Data/scripts/spawners.lua:127-206). Ambient life at walk-density level (spawns row 23).

briefs.label: Panic scatter
briefs.why: A group that is attacked breaks away for a set time, which makes a fight read as a reaction.
briefs.keep: panic as a timed state tied to the group; a list of who started it
briefs.change: a shorter, tighter scatter with our gait and sound cue; return rule tied to our threat list

briefs.label: Probability slot with anchor flag
briefs.why: A slot holds a squad with a spawn chance; a 100-percent slot stays as an anchor.
briefs.keep: a chance field and an anchor flag per slot
briefs.change: our fields (cap, chance, respawn, grace, coverage) and naming; anchors become boss stands

briefs.label: Tray with empty-state plates
briefs.why: Each slot shows an empty plate; an icon layer appears when filled, so the state reads at a glance.
briefs.keep: separate empty plate and icon overlay per slot
briefs.change: our slot count, palette and a bigger touch target at 375 wide
